items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Cleanhair got up and started to singing... I come out of that kitchen and run right down front. I said, "This is what I want."

ctx.x: So, I'm out there listening to the band at this roadhouse. They split up the band. I'm in the kitchen. And Cleanhair got up and started to singing. He wasn't singing with the band. He started to singing the blues. I come out of that kitchen and run right down front. I said,
